events.text: GAP YY — pieces ignore painted terrain height. Ghost tracks hover great (VV fix confirmed by user) but placement lands at the flat storey plane: resolvePlacement returns y: levelY (cart/editor/world/pieces.ts:181, levelY = floor*3m, 0 on Ground) and IsoStage.groundPoint (isoStage.ts:128) intersects the y=level plane analytically — neither samples the painted height channel. The brush places strokes on the mesa correctly because the HOST raycasts its own paint heightfields (paintGroundHitAt, world_loader.zig:6870; terrainSurfaceAt :2403) — that exact math needs a door: __compiled_world_ground_hit(nodeId, px, py) -> terrain hit, consumed by resolveSnap so ghost+placement+validation all use the surface Y (see-it == place-it). Flat-plane fallback when no field under the cursor. USER RULING same round: paint mode and build mode may NEVER be active together — 'only one at a time' (gap WW promoted from wave-2 hold to NOW).

GAP ZZ — tile TEXTURE picker popover is click-through: MapTexturePicker (stage/MapTexturePicker.tsx:51-53, absolute popover at left 410/top 122, rendered late at AppFrame root ~2309 with working Pressables) overlaps the viewport pane, and while paint is armed the HOST claims every pointer event inside the loader pane rect (__compiled_world_set_paint_mode → paintPointer, world_loader.zig) BEFORE JS hit-testing — the host knows nothing of JS overlays, so picker clicks stroke the map instead ('passes through to the editor'). JS-side paint order is fine (root-late child). Fix: modal-discipline gate (req_2626 law) — while texturePickerOpen (or any overlay above the pane), release the host pointer claim: gate the paintActive prop AppFrame feeds WorldEditorSurface with !texturePickerOpen. Dispatched as addendum to the WW mode-arbitration agent (same file, same law).
